store.description: An unofficial skate. 3 fan game built in Rust, running in the browser. Drop into a full 3D city, flick your board, grind rails and land a clean line — no download, no EA account.
features: Full 3D skate city rendered in the browser
Flick tricks, grinds and manuals with WASD + mouse
Rust engine build — no plugin, no install
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
